user.title: Connect Bakaláři
user.description: Enter your school's Bakaláři URL and credentials. Add a separate integration entry for another account.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect Bakaláři
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your school's Bakaláři URL and credentials. Add a separate integration entry for another account.

reconfigure.title: Connect Bakaláři
reconfigure.description: Enter your school's Bakaláři URL and credentials. Add a separate integration entry for another account.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTP(S) school URL without query parameters.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or the server returned invalid data.

abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to another account or server. Add a separate integration.

init.title: Polling options
init.description: Details include limited metadata and may be stored in history. Names, titles and senders may contain personal information visible to other HA users. Message bodies are never exposed. Changes apply after saving.

read_only.message: The account is in read-only mode. Writes and creating web login URLs are disabled.

apology_dates.message: The absence end must be after its start.

apology_response.message: The school API returned invalid excuse types or recipients. No excuse was sent.

apology_unavailable.message: The OMLUVENKA message type is unavailable for this account. Check permissions with your school.

apology_recipient.message: Cannot identify the class teacher: there is no unique default or sole permitted teacher for excuses. No excuse was sent.

apology_times.message: Supply both start and end times as local times without a time zone. Nonexistent or ambiguous times during DST changes are not allowed.

apology_preview_response.message: dry_run preview requires a response variable (response_variable).

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Refreshes all enabled modules for the account.

query.name: Query API
query.description: Returns the documented endpoint response to response_variable.

parameters.name: Query parameters
parameters.description: Use ISO dates for from and to. Supply identifiers without URL encoding.

mark_message_read.name: Mark message as read
mark_message_read.description: Marks a message as read on the school server.

set_homework_done.name: Set homework completion
set_homework_done.description: Changes the student's Finished flag on the school server.

confirm_marks.name: Confirm marks
confirm_marks.description: Confirms the selected marks on the school server.

predict_marks.name: Predict average
predict_marks.description: Returns the school's prediction using existing and hypothetical marks.

send_message.name: Send Komens message
send_message.description: Sends a message to the selected recipients. Only OBECNA and OMLUVENKA are allowed. Query message_types for recipients.

send_apology.name: Send absence excuse
send_apology.description: Sends an excuse to the default or sole teacher allowed for this account’s excuses. Without times, dates include entire days in the HA time zone. dry_run returns a preview; sending requires read-only mode to be disabled.

time_from.name: Start time
time_from.description: Optional HH:MM:SS in the HA time zone; also supply end time. School handling is unverified.

time_to.name: End time
time_to.description: Optional HH:MM:SS in the HA time zone; also supply start time.

title.name: Title
title.description: Defaults to Omluvenka DD.MM.YYYY using the first absence day.

dry_run.name: Preview only
dry_run.description: No POST or coordinator refresh. Requires response_variable; works in read-only mode. Preview includes the reason for absence.

reason.name: Reason for absence
reason.description: Excuse text sent to the teacher. May appear in automation traces.

write_classbook.name: Write classbook
write_classbook.description: Writes a classbook record using teacher permissions. record.Id must match record_id.

get_attachment.name: Get attachment
get_attachment.description: Returns Base64 content and MIME type for an attachment up to 5 MiB.

web_login.name: Web login
web_login.description: Returns a one-time login URL. Treat this URL as an account credential.
